title: "The exercise"
subtitle: "Analyst no. 6"
---

This page sets out the exercise of the Extended course, task by task, with the tool in which each task is done. The [background page](../../background.qmd) presents the original study, the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026) and the five reanalyses in full, and it is the place to start if you have not read it. The tasks fall on the second day, which is the [full-day format](../day/index.qmd), and are done in the workspace that you download and open in your IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), while the deck used on that day shows each step with its output. If your installation fails, the deck and the [browser lab](../../lab.qmd), which runs the exercise in a browser tab with the data in place, carry the work, and both give the same numbers as the workspace.

## The tasks {#the-tasks}

The course takes all five tasks on its second day, Task 1 in Part 1 of the workshop, Task 2 in Part 2, Task 3 in Part 3, and Tasks 4 and 5 in Part 4, and the page of each part lists its steps. Each task below says what to do in the workspace and, where it differs, in the browser lab.

{{< include ../../_includes/_exercise-tasks.qmd >}}

### After the five tasks {#after-the-five-tasks}

At the end of the second day you start the build of the file of respondents in the workspace, as [Before day 3](day-2.qmd#before-day-3) sets out, and on the third day the analysis that you declared in Task 5 becomes a short report, written in Quarto and kept under Git in the same workspace, as [Your report](day-3.qmd#your-report) sets out.
